desc: HZD-specific paths and names the converter uses to find content in the player's install (D32: no HZD path or name literal in code). Owner svet. Values are format facts established from the data (see docs/notes/svet.md) or design picks.

value.desc: string, number, list or object; the converter reads it through Hzs.Generated (HzdContentSheet)

rows.desc: Packed_DX12/<name>.bin opened in this order; later archives override (Patch last); Initial and Remainder are required
archives that must exist (the others are optional)
archive folder under the HZD install
Oodle library loaded in place from the HZD install (never copied)
PrefetchList with the resource path list
prefix of data-source locations pointing at .core.stream files
main world (DLC1 world out of v1)
tile folder; {x}/{y} = sign + 2 digits (x04, x-01)
tile-relative file whose presence marks a terrain tile (cell)
tile-relative WorldDataTextureMap with the 1024^2 R_UNORM_16 heights (m = raw/32)
tile-relative terrain colour texture
max size of the per-cell albedo.png (the flattened albedo bake is 2048^2 = 0.25 m/px; 1024 halves the file)

_evidence.value: svet: fix round: tile 4,-3 bake is 2048x2048 BC1; design pick: full resolution

rows.desc: tile-relative folder of static geometry layer files
layer file names containing one of these are cinematic/quest/lighting dressing and are not placed
mesh resources whose Name contains one of these are shadow / occluder chains (not visible geometry)
mesh files under these prefixes are merged far-LOD proxies / baked copies

_evidence.value: svet: S6: 2131 of 2141 baked vegetation instances duplicate the hand-placed layer

rows.desc: tile-relative layer with the campfire SceneInstances
SceneInstance.Prefab path substring that marks a campfire
id for a campfire SceneInstance without a Name
tile-relative layer with the named AIMarkers
AIMarker of the start village centre (Mother's Heart) in the start cell
start position = this far from the start campfire towards the marker, on the terrain
tile-relative folder of scene layers
scene sub folders that hold fixed machine sites (worldencounters = random, skipped)
site layer files end with this
AIBehaviorGroupMember.SpawnSetup path -> original machine type (group 1)
tile-relative 512^2 RGBA density map
tile-relative PlacementLayer file
density map channels R, G, B, A (WorldDataTextureMapEntry names)
second path segment of placement node resources (ecotopes/placement_nodes/<category>/...)
placement node category folder -> density channel
most used species kept per channel
tile-relative WorldDataTextureMap holding the ecotope effect channel (snow / frost amount)

_evidence.value: svet: vegetation round: tile 4,-3 entries topo_roads R, topo_water G, topo_objects B, ecotope_effect A

rows.desc: WorldDataType of the ecotope effect: entry of the effect map, and the map density graphs look up for snow / frost / no-snow plant variants
global factor on HZD vegetation density (cell.json species per_m2, expected, max_instances); 1 = HZD density

_evidence.value: svet: design pick for performance (HZD ground cover is up to 4 per m2)

rows.desc: cap of cell.json species max_instances (per species and cell)
per channel: instances per scatter point and their spread radius (cell.json species cluster); lets the game place fewer, denser clumps

_evidence.value: svet: design pick (HZD data has no clusters; WanderingDistance is exported as wander_m)

rows.desc: path segment of a machine model's animation folder (skeleton helpers live below it)
files under the animation folder containing this hold SkeletonHelpers
helper joint suffix (lower case); a rigid part without a destructibility attachment uses the helper named like its mesh file
SkinnedModelResource names containing this are the corrupted variant (not used for the initial pose)
machine sound folder; {internal} = hzd_internal_name
wave resources live in folders containing this
sound role -> ordered wave-name substrings (first patterns win)

_evidence.value: svet: S7 wave name groups of scout/horse/harvester

rows.desc: role used when a role has no matching waves
max waves exported per role
MusicResource with the world music echo bank
music cue -> tracks: exact names (@ = systems row), names ending with, then a family (name contains) ordered by the number after the last '-' (suffix) or by name, at most max
cue the game plays while exploring (audio.json music_explore)
cue the game plays in combat (audio.json music_combat)
kind / file prefix of the sounds taken from systems audio.ambience_track
EnvironmentSounds of systems audio.ambience_track used
waves exported per ambience folder
shorter waves are skipped
extra ambience folders (campfire loop)
texture sources tried for base colour, in order (asset folder, shared shader libraries, texture library)
texture paths containing one of these are never used as base colour
machine models only take base colour from their own asset textures
a bound Texture outside any texture set is a colour map when its path contains one of these (its alpha is translucency, not a mask)

_evidence.value: svet: fix round: carex grass binds a colour+translucency texture and an alpha-only texture set

rows.desc: colourised assets (no colour map, stone x AO) are pulled this far towards the baked terrain colour under the instance (cell.json instances[].tint; 0 = neutral stone)
